title: Dynamical analysis of r-Chialvo neuron map with cosine memristive
summary: In this work, we construct a novel two-dimensional discrete neuron map by incorporating a cosine-based memristor into the reduced Chialvo neuron map to examine the dynamical analysis of electromagnetic modulation. The nonlinear current-voltage characteristics of the memristor enrich the neuron map's behavior, leading to diverse firing regimes, stability behaviors, and chaotic attractors.
